title: The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure…
description: The Forminator Forms WordPress plugin up to version 1.57.3.1 contains an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability via the 'previous_draft_id' parameter. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers who have obtained a victim's draft ID (e.g., from a shared 'continue later' link) to delete and overwrite saved drafts belonging to other users. The nonce intended to protect this action is publicly accessible and does not prevent exploitation.
